mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transport_tasks WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM transport_tasks WHERE id=#{id} AND rider_id=#{riderId}
SELECT * FROM transport_tasks WHERE rider_id=#{riderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_tasks SET item_name=#{name},item_description=#{description},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND rider_id=#{riderId} AND status='READY'
UPDATE transport_tasks SET status='ACTIVE',started_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND rider_id=#{riderId} AND status='READY'
UPDATE transport_tasks SET status='COMPLETED',ended_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND rider_id=#{riderId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id,transport_no FROM transport_tasks WHERE active_box_key=#{boxId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(n.node_id) AS required_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.online=1 AND r.last_seen>=#{since} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS online_count FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN node_runtime r ON r.node_id=n.node_id WHERE n.box_id=#{boxId} AND n.required=1
SELECT assessment,active,level FROM alarm_state WHERE box_id=#{boxId}
